changes.reason: Preserve the categorical assertion about the sole apex predator rather than weakening it to a possibility.

preserved: Kohr-Ah cleansing/extermination and Kzer-Za enslavement/imprisonment remain distinct doctrines; neither is justified by narrator additions.
The key phrase and its historical echo remain identical; temporary explanation does not promise mercy.
Over 5,000 races, over 20,000 years, 3,000 years, thousands of years, weeks, years and months retain their original scope.
Milieu counts retain their chronological context: six encountered races, six conquered non-Taalo races, five other survivors and three remaining races.
Taalo immunity is explicitly a belief; Taalo nonresistance, coerced extermination and Mael-Num escape remain as narrated.
SENSE_EVIL fear and ancestral memories are exceptional, not the default register. Bone-pit first-person singular and collective doctrine remain distinct.
OUT_TAKES preserves failed pronunciation and the shift from in-character declarations to addressing the director.
All source record IDs, order and dialogue boundaries are unchanged.
limitations: Agent review is not user approval.
